summary: Ashland County lookout tower that the Forest Fire Lookout Association lists as gone; no other source found on its history.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no source describes what, if anything, remains at the site.

evidence.supports: listed as a lookout tower in Ashland County at 46.15568, -90.74151, status gone

notes_for_editor: Single source: the FFLA Wisconsin list gives name, county, coordinates and gone status, which match the record. It is not on the Central US Wisconsin page. Wikipedia's Moose Hill article is a Massachusetts hill near Sharon and is not this tower; do not cite it. About two web searches and about five reads. The story is about 45 words, well under the 120-word floor, because nothing else is on record. A local newspaper or Chequamegon-Nicolet history search is the next step. Confidence low.
